policy.decision: No active High/Critical dependency exceptions after the Expo SDK 56 migration; React Native 0.85 reintroduces @react-native/metro-config as a real dependency of react-native-worklets and the community CLI plugin, but Metro 0.84 no longer depends on image-size, so the previously excepted advisories stay uninstalled

resolvedInSdk53.reason: Expo SDK 52 pins the affected archive library through its local CLI and cache tooling; a compatible patched version requires the coordinated Expo SDK upgrade.
resolvedInSdk53.mitigation: The package is not a direct application or Worker dependency. CI installs only the committed lockfile and processes trusted project/build inputs on ephemeral runners.
resolvedInSdk53.remediation: Upgrade Expo and React Native as one tested SDK set, remove this exception immediately when npm audit no longer reports it, and regenerate the release evidence.

resolvedInSdk55.reason: Expo SDK 53 pinned PostCSS through Metro configuration for local bundling.
resolvedInSdk55.mitigation: Builds processed repository-controlled CSS only on isolated runners with the committed lockfile.
resolvedInSdk55.remediation: Expo SDK 55 resolves PostCSS to 8.5.26, outside the affected advisory range.

resolvedInDependencyMaintenance.reason: React Native 0.83.10 still pins image-size 1.2.1 through Metro asset processing; the parser is used while building local assets and is not shipped as application logic.
resolvedInDependencyMaintenance.mitigation: Only repository-controlled image assets are processed, dependency installation is lockfile-pinned, and CI builds run on isolated ephemeral runners without untrusted uploads.
resolvedInDependencyMaintenance.remediation: The controlled September 2026 lockfile refresh removed the unused optional React Native Metro peer chain and image-size from the installation.
